query: Inuvik Northwest Territories Canada taxi fare per km
source: Town of Inuvik official taxi fare rate poster
snippet: Inuvik taxi fare cited at 6.00 CAD per km (highest in Canada per one source). Fares regulated by town bylaw, based on number of passengers: starting C$25 for one person, C$14 each for two people, C$10 per person for three, plus 25 cents per excess kilometre. Two operators: Delta Cabs and United Taxi.
